import sympy as S
x,t=S.symbols('x t',nonzero=True)
omega=1/(x-t)+2/(x+t**2);phi=t/(x-t)-(x+t**2)**2/t;rho=1/t
actual=S.diff(omega,t)+S.diff(phi,t)*omega+S.diff(rho,t)/rho*omega
full=S.diff(omega*S.exp(phi)*rho,t)/(S.exp(phi)*rho)
r=full-actual
print('raw zero:',r==0)
print('simplify:',S.simplify(r))
print('expand_power_exp then cancel:',S.cancel(S.expand_power_exp(r)))
print('factor_terms:',S.factor_terms(r))
